_readme: Owner 27–29 Oct 2026: network covers these cities; same OGRA per-kg nationwide; delivery target ~1 hour when local team available. Use deliveryNote and localNotes on city hubs for trust + coverage copy. Street coverage still confirmed on each order.

localNotes: Islamabad and adjoining ICT sectors are served through our distributor network from the G-12 office catchment.
Winter demand rises for domestic cylinders and heaters across the twin cities; keep a spare exchange cylinder where you can store it safely.
Diplomatic enclaves, Blue Area offices and housing societies often need scheduled commercial changeovers — tell us weekly volume when you inquire.
Orders via call, WhatsApp or the website are accepted around the clock; a local team or distributor confirms the delivery window.
islamabad.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Islamabad areas when a local team is available; otherwise the distributor contacts you to confirm timing.

localNotes: Rawalpindi twin-city demand is fulfilled through the same Islamabad–Rawalpindi network teams.
Domestic 11.8 kg and commercial 45.4 kg are the most requested sizes for homes, Saddar kitchens and Bahria / Satellite Town belts.
Cantonment and dense old-city streets need a clear landmark and access note (truck or pickup) before dispatch.
Same-day refill and exchange are arranged when empty cylinders are ready for pickup.
rawalpindi.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Rawalpindi areas when a local team is available; timing confirmed on each order.

localNotes: Lahore is served by multiple network distributors with teams covering major residential and commercial belts from Model Town to DHA and Johar Town.
Commercial kitchens commonly use 45.4 kg cylinders; homes typically use 11.8 kg or 15 kg.
Foggy winter mornings and monsoon waterlogging can stretch the last mile — we confirm your street before you agree.
We quote OGRA-notified gas price plus confirmed delivery and cylinder terms before you agree.
lahore.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Lahore areas when a local team is available; otherwise the distributor contacts you personally.

localNotes: Karachi has the densest partner coverage in our network and handles high domestic and commercial volume across both sides of the city.
Coastal humidity makes cylinder condition checks on delivery especially important — refuse damaged bottles and cracked hoses.
Port, industrial and bulk enquiries are routed separately from domestic refills; send site load when you ask for a bank or bulk quote.
Traffic on Shahrah-e-Faisal, Korangi and Lyari corridors can change the window — we confirm timing before dispatch.
karachi.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Karachi areas when a local team is available; timing confirmed before dispatch.

localNotes: Faisalabad combines heavy domestic demand with textile mills, power-loom belts and workshop commercial loads.
11.8 kg and 45.4 kg are the sizes most ordered for homes and industrial kitchens.
Mill and estate sites that need banks or scheduled routes should state weekly changeover volume and gate access.
Named dealers and research distributors for the city are listed on this hub.
faisalabad.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Faisalabad areas when a local team is available; timing confirmed on each order.

localNotes: Peshawar is a main Khyber Pakhtunkhwa hub for domestic refill and commercial kitchen supply.
Hospitality and hospital catering often need 45.4 kg banks with reliable changeover.
University Town, Hayatabad and cantonment belts are among localities we check first — send your exact colony.
We confirm your locality against listed partners before dispatch.
peshawar.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Peshawar areas when a local team is available; otherwise your distributor confirms the window.

localNotes: Multan serves city and surrounding belt demand including farms and commercial kitchens.
Summer heat is extreme; keep cylinders upright in shade. Winter cooking still drives regular domestic refill cycles.
Wedding and sweet-shop seasons stack 45.4 kg changeovers — tell us weekly volume for commercial sites.
Send your area with the order so we match the right local team.
multan.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Multan areas when a local team is available; timing confirmed before you agree.

localNotes: Gujranwala partners cover residential colonies and busy commercial streets on the GT Road corridor.
Workshops, metalware units and restaurants commonly request 45.4 kg alongside home 11.8 kg refills.
Narrow colony lanes may need a pickup instead of a truck — say so when you order.
24-hour opening is listed for some partners — hours are reconfirmed when you order.
gujranwala.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Gujranwala areas when a local team is available; timing confirmed on each order.

localNotes: Quetta is our primary Balochistan hub for cylinders and housing-society engineering.
Winter cold increases heater and geyser demand; keep a spare exchange cylinder where you can store it safely.
Hill and weather conditions can extend windows — we confirm timing honestly on the call.
Satellite Town, Nawa Killi and similar belts are among localities we check first; farther settlements need exact pins.
quetta.deliveryNote: Target about 60–90 minutes in covered Quetta areas when a local team is available; weather and roads can change the window, confirmed before dispatch.

localNotes: Hyderabad supports Sindh demand beyond Karachi for homes, Latifabad / Qasimabad colonies and commercial kitchens.
Summer heat and Indus-belt humidity call for shaded, upright cylinder storage and a hose check on every delivery.
Named suppliers from our network appear in the directory on this page.
Same OGRA per-kg rate as the rest of Pakistan; delivery terms confirmed locally.
hyderabad.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Hyderabad areas when a local team is available; timing confirmed on each order.

localNotes: Burewala sits on the southern Punjab cotton and citrus belt with steady domestic and workshop demand.
Listed localities include Shah Faisal Colony, Yaqoob Abad and I Block — confirm your street when you order.
Farms and small processing units around the city often need 45.4 kg or scheduled refill routes.
Partner density is thinner than Lahore; we confirm reach and timing on every call.
burewala.deliveryNote: Target about one hour in covered Burewala areas when a local team is available; timing confirmed on each order.

localNotes: Abbottabad winters raise heater and geyser demand; order before the cylinder runs empty.
Steep streets and fog or rain on Hazara roads can extend windows — we confirm honestly on the call.
Hostels, colleges and hotels on the Galiyat route commonly use 45.4 kg cylinders.
abbottabad.deliveryNote: Target about 60–90 minutes in covered Abbottabad areas when a local team is available; hill roads and weather can change the window, confirmed before dispatch.

localNotes: Gilgit is the main Gilgit-Baltistan hub; cold winters drive cooking, heating and hot-water use.
Karakoram Highway closures from snow or landslides can delay supply — we say what is realistic when you order.
Jutial and central Gilgit are among localities we check first; valleys farther out need exact locations.
gilgit.deliveryNote: Timing in Gilgit depends on mountain roads and weather. When a local team can reach you we confirm a realistic window before you agree — often longer than plains cities.

localNotes: Murree demand spikes on weekends, summer holidays and snowfall days for hotels and guesthouses.
Snow and ice on steep hill roads can delay or stop delivery; we do not promise a fixed hour on bad weather days.
A named research distributor appears for the Murree Hills belt; supply is also coordinated from the Islamabad–Rawalpindi side when needed.
Confirm your exact locality (Mall Road side, Patriata approach or lower hills) when you inquire.
murree.deliveryNote: Hill roads and weather set the window in Murree. We confirm a realistic time on the call and do not promise a fixed hour on snowfall or heavy-traffic days.

localNotes: Muzaffarabad climbs steep ground between the Jhelum and Neelum — upper wards need a clear landmark and access note.
Monsoon rain and landslides can close AJK approaches; we confirm a realistic window rather than a plains-city hour.
Named network and research listings for the city appear in the directory on this page; street reach is still confirmed on the call.
Winter heating load rises in higher wards; order before the cylinder runs empty.
muzaffarabad.deliveryNote: Target about 60–90 minutes in covered Muzaffarabad areas when a local team is available; hill roads and weather can change the window, confirmed before dispatch.

localNotes: Skardu winters are long and cold; cooking, heaters and hot water drive most household demand.
Mountain roads (and occasional air links when roads fail) set supply timing — we say what is realistic on the call.
A named research distributor is listed for Skardu; we still confirm whether a run can reach your street that week.
Hotels and trekking operators should plan 45.4 kg banks before the short tourist peak.
skardu.deliveryNote: Timing in Skardu depends on mountain roads and weather. When a local team can reach you we confirm a realistic window before you agree — often longer than plains cities.
